verdict: A very close, well-placed rebuild whose worst gaps are uneven letter-spacing in body text and a few wrong glyphs (outlined profile, chimney-less home), on a clean flex structure with templates for the repeated rows.

top_defects.where: card text and Top read rows
top_defects.what: global tracking-[-0.23px] plus per-text tracking makes spacing uneven: 'Foot balleur', 'souter rain', 'pre mier', 'sondages' gaps visible; reference has even SF Pro spacing
'Community', 'Which came first?', 'Games', tab labels set wider/letter-spaced than the reference; event lines sit ~2-3 px lower per line (leading 20.5 px vs ~20 px)
outlined Lucide circle-user-round instead of the filled person-in-circle glyph

top_defects.where: tab bar Home, card calendar, Star Academy thumbnail
top_defects.what: home glyph without chimney/door cut-out, calendar with rings instead of the flat grid calendar, Star Academy logo cropped differently
nearly opaque white capsule (bg-white/95) where the reference's Liquid Glass shows the feed (row 2 description, rank circle) blurred through it, with a light rim

top_defects.where: Top read rows 2-3 under the tab bar
top_defects.what: row 2 description hidden instead of showing through; row 3 truncates 'réalité m' vs 'réalité mu…'
Games and Top read headers/cards copy-pasted with identical arbitrary classes (174 arbitrary values) instead of a shared component
SVG recoloured with a CSS filter chain (invert/sepia/hue-rotate) rather than a coloured icon

strengths: Every block (top bar, segmented control, Today, Card hidden, both sections, tab bar) lands within a few px of the reference
All reference texts present with accents, plus the real thumbnails and Wikipedia W logo
Event rows, article rows and tab items are templates with data, inside flex columns that reflow
